text_block_list.text:
After claiming victory in the Satsuki Sho,
Symboli
Rudolf raises one finger high.
The message is
clear: one crown down,
two to go. Up next is the
Japanese
Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, Эйр Грув and the
general
manager visit the waiting room,
where Symboli
Rudolf waxes lyrical
about her dream.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Moved, the general manager decides to
remain in
the student council, but Air
Groove seems
displeased with Rudolf's
handling of the situation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
